sceneConcept: A composed thirty-five-year-old Chinese medical-technology experience consultant stands alone against a transparent background with the steady posture of a former rehabilitation nurse. Her shoulder-length brown bob frames gentle eyes and a warm closed-mouth smile. Wearing an unmarked muted-green showroom blazer over a white collared shirt and black trousers, she rests one hand at her chest and extends the other palm to invite a visitor to explain their discomfort, under soft even frontal light.
